scripts.build: npm run build -w @flowdesk/shared && npm run build -w @flowdesk/api && npm run build -w @flowdesk/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @flowdesk/shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @flowdesk/shared" "npm run dev -w @flowdesk/api" "npm run dev -w @flowdesk/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @flowdesk/shared && npm run test -w @flowdesk/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @flowdesk/shared && npm run typecheck -w @flowdesk/api && npm run typecheck -w @flowdesk/web
